🎥🎬: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The legendary Vermont State Troopers are back, and this time their latest assignment pushes their questionable skills to the limit. When a routine case turns into a full-blown mess involving bizarre criminals, unexpected twists, and their own chaotic approach to justice, the team must work together to prove that their unique style of policing still gets results.

With the return of the original cast, Super Troopers 3 brings back the outrageous humor, unforgettable pranks, and ridiculous chemistry that made the franchise a comedy cult favorite. Filled with wild encounters, nonstop laughs, and the signature nonsense fans have been waiting for, the troopers are ready for another unforgettable ride.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
